desc_zh: 最基础的玻璃器皿，配溶液、隔水加热都靠它，柜台上摆一摞永远不嫌多。
desc_en: The humblest glass on the shelf. Mixing and water baths both start here.

desc_zh: 底宽口窄摇一摇不洒，当铺收来的样品多半装在里面。
desc_en: Wide base and narrow neck. Most samples that come through the pawnshop end up in one.

desc_zh: 圆肚子受热均匀，煮沸和回流的老伙计，缺它很多反应做不成。
desc_en: A round belly for even heating. The old hand for boiling and reflux.

desc_zh: 一条刻度定生死，配标准溶液少了它只能凭眼估，价钱也就贵在这条线上。
desc_en: One line decides everything. No standard solution gets mixed without it.

desc_zh: 一支小管子随手就能试出这瓶货是真是假，摔了也不心疼。
desc_en: A little tube that tells you in seconds whether the goods are real.

desc_zh: 木架一排孔，试管插上去，柜台立刻有作坊的样子。
desc_en: A row of holes in wood. Pop the tubes in and the counter looks like a workshop.

desc_zh: 细长身子一排刻度，量体积比拿眼睛估靠谱得多。
desc_en: A tall body full of marks. Far more reliable than eyeballing a volume.

desc_zh: 一滴也算数，贵重试剂全靠它省着用。
desc_en: Every drop counts. Fine reagents are rationed with this.

desc_zh: 一滴一滴往下放，终点到了就该收手，测含量的活儿离不开它。
desc_en: Drip by drip until the endpoint says stop. No content test is done without it.

desc_zh: 浅浅一碟养点什么都行，也常拿来晾干样品和分装粉末。
desc_en: A shallow dish that grows anything and doubles as a drying tray.

desc_zh: 不值钱的搅棍，可没有它连盐都化不开。
desc_en: A cheap stirring stick. Without it even salt will not dissolve.

desc_zh: 盖住烧杯挡灰，也能托着粉末上秤，一物两用的小件。
desc_en: Covers a beaker against dust and carries powder to the scale.

desc_zh: 拧开就是蓝火苗，当铺里所有加热活儿的第一把火。
desc_en: One twist and there is a blue flame. The first fire of any heating job.

desc_zh: 把烧瓶裹进怀里慢慢煨，比明火温柔也更安全。
desc_en: Wraps the flask and warms it slowly. Gentler and safer than open flame.

desc_zh: 瓷土小碗耐得住烈火，烧完往往只剩一坨值钱的货。
desc_en: A clay bowl that survives the fire and leaves something worth selling.

desc_zh: 捣碎结块的货，磨得越细卖相越好。
desc_en: Grinds the clumped goods fine. The finer the powder the better it sells.

desc_zh: 差一毫都不行，称贵金属和细粉全靠它，镇得住场子。
desc_en: Not a hair off. Precious metal and fine powder are weighed here.

desc_zh: 火候全靠这根水银柱说话，差几度就是废品和好货的分界。
desc_en: The mercury column has the final say on the heat.

desc_zh: 一插就知道酸还是碱，省下用舌头试的危险活儿。
desc_en: One dip tells acid from base and saves your tongue the danger.

desc_zh: 镇店的高价货，扫一眼就报出成分，值不值全看它说话。
desc_en: The expensive piece in the shop. One scan names the contents.

desc_zh: 把混在一起的货色一层层分开，谁也骗不过它。
desc_en: Separates a mixed batch layer by layer. Nobody cheats this one.

desc_zh: 转起来就把重的沉的甩到底，上层清液卖相干净。
desc_en: Spin it and the heavy parts sink. The clear liquid sells clean.

desc_zh: 一锅浑汤进去，出来就是能卖钱的纯货，提纯的看家本事。
desc_en: Murky brew goes in and pure goods worth money come out.

desc_zh: 油是油水是水，一拧开关各走各路。
desc_en: Oil is oil and water is water. One turn and each takes its path.

desc_zh: 垫张滤纸渣子留下清液进瓶，最便宜的一道提纯。
desc_en: A paper cone in it. Grit stays behind and clear liquid goes in the bottle.

desc_zh: 凑近看一眼假货的棱角就藏不住了，验货的硬家伙。
desc_en: Take a close look and the fake's rough edges show.

desc_zh: 有毒的烟气都往柜子里抽，人站在外面安心数钱。
desc_en: The poison goes up the hood while you count money outside.

desc_zh: 边加热边转圈，一锅反应不用人守着，省下的是时间也是命。
desc_en: Heats and spins at once. A reaction that needs no babysitter.

desc_zh: 高压一闷什么活物都清干净，玻璃器皿也顺带消了毒。
desc_en: Pressure kills everything alive and sterilizes the glass while it is at it.

desc_zh: 滴定管锥形瓶架子配齐，测含量一步到位，整套出手更值钱。
desc_en: Burette plus flask plus stand. One setup measures the content.

desc_zh: 护住一对招子，溅出来的酸可不讲道理。
desc_en: Guards your eyes. Splashed acid does not negotiate.

desc_zh: 白大褂一穿脏东西沾在布上，别拿新衣服去赌。
desc_en: The white coat takes the stain so your shirt does not.
